test_only_reason: Closes acceptance gaps of P3-HIERARCHY-TYPES: the Def 4.1 checker and the reference hierarchy already exist; these tests pin Q-21 (zero-length cycles) and height changes of the reference hierarchy without changing the implementation
spec: A zero-length directed cycle through >= 2 states is reported as H3 at the lowest node containing it (or H4 if it spans several trees) for every forest; zero-length self-arcs and acyclic zero arcs are accepted; raising a reference-hierarchy height above its merge threshold (incl. the 2W variant) violates H3 at that node, while monotone heights at most the thresholds stay valid with c0 = ceil(max link / h)

events.command: bash -c 'cmake --build --preset debug && ctest --preset debug -R "Q-21|reference heights" && ctest --preset debug'
